# Clikiti

> Clikiti helps web agencies and freelancers win new clients. It finds prospects that fit the agency, scans each prospect's website for usability, accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA) and speed issues, rebuilds their homepage with their own brand and content, and packages the audit and the redesign as one link the agency sends before the first call.

Clikiti is a prospecting and pitching tool, not a website builder for end clients. The redesign is a sales concept: once the prospect signs, the agency builds the real site in its own stack.

## How it works

1. Discover: find businesses that match your ideal client profile by niche, city and size.
2. Scan: four agents audit the site in parallel.
3. Redesign: the prospect's homepage is rebuilt in about a minute, fixing the issues found and keeping their brand.
4. Send: the audit and the redesign become one branded link you send through your own email, LinkedIn or phone. Clikiti never contacts prospects for you.

## The four scan agents

- Whiskers (the curious one): UX heuristics · content · navigation.
- Shadow (the sneaky one): Accessibility · edge cases · security.
- Tiger (the aggressive one): Speed · page weight · load.
- Paws (the clumsy one): QA · forms · duplicate actions.

## Pricing (USD)

- Scan: $0, forever. Usability, accessibility and speed scan with score, verdict and top findings. No sign-up, no card.
- Starter: $49/month, 15 redesign pitches (about $3.27 each). For solo freelancers warming up their first cold list. Includes: 15 warmed lead magnets / month; Full site audit on every prospect; Complete homepage redesign per lead; Sendable pitch asset (audit + redesign); Sales kit with your branding (small "Made with Clikiti" line); Discovery by your ideal client profile; Email support.
- Growth: $129/month, 50 redesign pitches (about $2.58 each). For freelancers and small studios pitching every week. Includes: 50 warmed lead magnets / month; Everything in Starter; Multiple ideal client profiles; Outreach kit: email, LinkedIn, call script; Fully white-label sales kits and proposals (no Clikiti badge); Your own report domain (reports.youragency.com); Priority support.
- Agency: $349/month, 150 redesign pitches (about $2.33 each). For teams running outbound at real volume. Includes: 150 warmed lead magnets / month; Everything in Growth, incl. white-label kits + report domain; Overage at $2.50 / extra design; AI spend + pipeline reporting; Team seats; Dedicated onboarding.

## Compared with alternatives

- Manual spec work (Figma, Adobe XD): often a day or more of designer time per prospect. Clikiti: about a minute, from about $2.33 per pitch.
- Audit-report tools (for example AuditPitch, MyWebAudit, Insites, MySiteAuditor, SEOptimer, WooRank): send written findings or PDFs. Clikiti also sends a finished homepage redesign built on the prospect's real brand.
- Lead-list tools (for example D7 Lead Finder): large contact lists by niche and city, with no audit or pitch. Clikiti finds fewer prospects and prepares a pitch for each.
- Site builders (for example Readdy, Lovable, Relume, Framer): build new sites from a prompt or list data; none lists an audit of a prospect's live site. Clikiti starts from the prospect's existing site and its real problems. They are the better tools for building the site after the client signs.

## FAQ

### Is the scan really free?
Yes. Paste any public homepage and you get the score, verdict, top findings and core metrics. No account, no card. The full findings list, the redesign and the sendable pitch are what you get with access.

### What exactly does the free scan check?
Three things on the page you enter: usability against core Nielsen heuristics (consistency, error prevention, clear labels), the WCAG 2.2 AA checks a machine can test (colour contrast, alt text, form labels, link names, headings, page language) and speed signals such as page weight, request count, heavy assets, compression and server response. Deeper checks and a multi-page crawl come with the full scan in your workspace.

### Does Clikiti contact prospects for me?
No. You stay in control of the relationship. Clikiti builds the audit and the redesign as one branded link, and you send it through your own inbox, LinkedIn or phone.

### Who gets access?
Agencies and freelancers who actively pitch web work and will tell us what to fix. We review every request by hand during the alpha.

## For AI agents

- [MCP server](https://clikiti.com/api/mcp) (Streamable HTTP): lists an agency's redesigns and returns each one's build brief and complete HTML, so a coding agent can rebuild the design in the agency's own codebase. Needs the agency's bearer token from Export > MCP in the app. [Server card](https://clikiti.com/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json), [API catalog](https://clikiti.com/.well-known/api-catalog).
- The homepage and every research post are also served as Markdown: request them with `Accept: text/markdown`.

## Clikiti for Figma

- [Clikiti Font Replacer & Restyle](https://clikiti.com/figma): a Figma plugin, coming to Figma Community. Free with no sign-in: a bulk font replacer (frame, page or whole file; every weight mapped to its nearest match; text styles updated; missing fonts fixed), a quick design scan, 12 designed looks or your own colours, a dark mode of your own page, 12 dark styles and Generate palette, every text pair checked to 4.5:1. Five free tries each, then a free Clikiti account: Page Sense (restyles each section for its job), suggested font pairs, switchable frames. With a Clikiti account: Build turns the frame into a real website, and Import brings a Clikiti page into Figma as layers.

## Free tools

Each runs the same free single-page scan, worded for one search intent.

- [All free tools](https://clikiti.com/tools)
- [Free website audit](https://clikiti.com/tools/free-website-audit): One scan, one score: usability, accessibility, speed, links and SEO basics.
- [Website grader](https://clikiti.com/tools/website-grader): A 0–100 grade with the verdict and the issues that cost the most points.
- [Accessibility checker](https://clikiti.com/tools/accessibility-checker): Automated WCAG 2.2 AA checks, with contrast measured from the page’s CSS.
- [Page weight & speed check](https://clikiti.com/tools/website-speed-test): Real page weight, request count and the files slowing a page down.
- [Free UX audit](https://clikiti.com/tools/ux-audit): A UX-lead style review: the verdict, the biggest problem and the friction points.

## Research reports

Quarterly "state of the web" reports, one industry each, from automated scans. Each has an HTML page, a PDF and a Markdown version written to be quoted.

- [All research](https://clikiti.com/research)
- [About Clikiti Research](https://clikiti.com/research/about): who runs the reports, the open-data licence (CC BY 4.0) and how to collaborate (hello@clikiti.com)
